title: お正月あそび クレヨン
subject_en: Traditional Japanese New Year games and toys, each a separate object, drawn in a warm crayon style with bright childlike colours. Every object has a closed, clearly darker outline; light parts (paper, rice cakes) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters or characters on the cards, kites or paper.
lead: こま、たこ、はねつき、かるた、ふくわらい、けん玉。園や学校のおたより1月号、お正月の遊びの説明、すごろくの素材に使える、クレヨンのタッチの12点。
items: a wooden spinning top with a red and blue stripe and a string
a traditional square Japanese kite with a red sun design and a long tail (no letters)
a decorated wooden paddle with a small shuttlecock beside it
a stack of blank playing cards with one card showing a simple picture of a rabbit
a round blank face board with separate eyebrow, eye, nose and mouth pieces beside it
a wooden kendama with a red ball on a string
a dice and a rolled-up board game sheet with a winding path of circles (no letters)
three small cloth beanbags with colourful patterns
a daruma-otoshi stack of colourful blocks with a small mallet
three round menko cards with simple patterns
a wooden mortar with a rice cake and a mallet
a brush and an ink stone beside a blank sheet of cream paper
